name: Kytheon Iora
description: An Akroan orphan and gang leader trained in hieromancy who made his first planeswalk to Bant and became the planeswalker Gideon Jura.

description_citations.text: "Akros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As an orphan on the streets the narrator resolves to become a legend greater than Kytheon Iora.
timeline.quote: I would be greater than Kytheon.

citation.text: "Desperate Stand" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Kytheon Iora leads a gang stealing from the rich and is imprisoned, where Hixus teaches him hieromancy.
timeline.quote: The prison warden, a man named Hixus , taught him Hieromancy, the magic of order.

citation.text: "Akros", section "Kytheon Iora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kytheon saves the Kolophon from harpies and cyclopes, defeats the titan of Erebos with Heliod's spear, then throws the spear at Erebos, who kills his irregulars; Kytheon first planeswalks to Bant and becomes Gideon Jura.
timeline.quote: Shocked and shamed by their deaths at his hand, Kytheon then made his first planeswalk to Bant, where he became known as Gideon Jura.

citation.text: "Akros", section "Kytheon Iora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grieving planeswalkers bury Gideon's breastplate outside Akros as a memorial and Nissa grows an oak.
timeline.quote: Nissa Revane planted an acorn and grew it into a massive oak tree next to the stone

citation.text: "Akros", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Heliod arms Kytheon and sends him after a Titan sent rampaging by Erebos, leading to his companions' deaths and his ascension as a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: It was Heliod who armed Kytheon (later known as Gideon ) and sent him after a Titan that Erebos had sent rampaging across Theros.

citation.text: "Desperate Stand" by Matt Knicl. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Apr 2014.
